+def http_request_json(url: str, method: str = "GET", payload: Optional[bytes] = None) -> Tuple[int, Dict[str, Any]]:
+    """发起单包 HTTP GET 或 POST 请求并返回 (状态码, 解析后的 JSON 字典)。"""
+    parsed = urllib.parse.urlsplit(url)
+    host, port, path = parsed.hostname or "127.0.0.1", parsed.port or 80, parsed.path or "/"
+    body_bytes = payload or b""
+    req_bytes = (
+        f"{method} {path} HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: {host}:{port}\r\n"
+        f"Content-Type: application/json\r\nContent-Length: {len(body_bytes)}\r\n"
+        f"Connection: close\r\n\r\n"
+    ).encode("utf-8") + body_bytes
+    with socket.create_connection((host, port), timeout=3.0) as sock:
+        sock.sendall(req_bytes)
+        chunks: List[bytes] = []
+        while True:
+            buf = sock.recv(4096)
+            if not buf:
+                break
+            chunks.append(buf)
+    hdr_text, _, body_text = b"".join(chunks).decode("utf-8", errors="replace").partition("\r\n\r\n")
+    tokens = hdr_text.splitlines()[0].split() if hdr_text else []
+    status_code = int(tokens[1]) if len(tokens) > 1 and tokens[1].isdigit() else 500
+    try:
+        return status_code, (json.loads(body_text) if body_text.strip() else {})
+    except ValueError:
+        return status_code, {"raw_error": body_text}

+def calc_crc16_ccitt(data: bytes) -> int:
+    """计算 MiniMCProto v2.0 使用的 CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE (poly=0x1021, init=0xFFFF)。"""
+    crc = 0xFFFF
+    for byte_val in data:
+        crc ^= (byte_val & 0xFF) << 8
+        for _ in range(8):
+            if (crc & 0x8000) != 0:
+                crc = ((crc << 1) ^ 0x1021) & 0xFFFF
+            else:
+                crc = (crc << 1) & 0xFFFF
+    return crc
+

+def build_minimc_v2_frame(src_id: int, dst_id: int, cmd_id: int, seq_payload: Tuple[int, bytes]) -> bytes:
+    """构造带合法 CRC-16 的 MiniMCProto v2.0 响应帧 (SOF=0x55 0xAA, flags=0x06)。"""
+    seq, payload = seq_payload
+    hdr = struct.pack(
+        "<BBBBBBBBHH",
+        0x55,
+        0xAA,
+        src_id & 0xFF,
+        dst_id & 0xFF,
+        0x06,
+        cmd_id & 0xFF,
+        9,
+        0,
+        seq & 0xFFFF,
+        len(payload),
+    )
+    body = hdr + payload
+    crc = calc_crc16_ccitt(body)
+    return body + struct.pack("<H", crc)
+

+def build_pty_response_for_req(frame: bytes, work_path: pathlib.Path, seq_state: Dict[str, int]) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    """根据 forward_service_daemon 发来的 0x01/0x14 请求帧构造虚拟 MCU 响应帧。"""
+    if len(frame) < 14 or frame[0] != 0x55 or frame[1] != 0xAA:
+        return None
+    dst_id = frame[3]
+    cmd_id = frame[5]
+    seq = struct.unpack("<H", frame[8:10])[0]
+    if cmd_id == 0x01 and dst_id in (2, 3):
+        commit = 0xA6791332 if dst_id == 2 else 0x6356C05A
+        boot_id = 0x01020304 if dst_id == 2 else 0x8877AA55
+        boot_id = 0x01020304 if dst_id == 2 else 0x8877AA55
+        cap = 3 if dst_id == 2 else 7
+        ver_payload = struct.pack("<BBBBIII", 2, 0, 2, 0, boot_id, commit, cap)
+        return build_minimc_v2_frame(dst_id, 1, 0x02, (seq, ver_payload))
+    if cmd_id == 0x14 and dst_id in (2, 3):
+        mode_file = work_path / "pty_mode"
+        mode = mode_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip() if mode_file.exists() else "ONLINE"
+        key = "mc_seq" if dst_id == 2 else "th_seq"
+        seq_state[key] = seq
+        (work_path / "pty_last_seq.json").write_text(json.dumps(seq_state), encoding="utf-8")
+        if mode == "OFFLINE":
+            temp_payload = struct.pack("<hhHBBII", WIRE_SENTINEL_OFFLINE, 0, 4095, 1, 0, 200, 0)
+        elif dst_id == 2:
+            temp_payload = struct.pack("<hhHBBII", 600, 600, 3200, 0, 0, 100, 0)
+        else:
+            temp_payload = struct.pack("<hhHBBII", 2100, 2100, 820, 0, 0, 110, 0)
+        return build_minimc_v2_frame(dst_id, 1, 0x14, (seq, temp_payload))
+    return None

+def pty_responder_loop(master_fd: int, work_path: pathlib.Path) -> None:
+    """后台子进程循环：监听 POSIX PTY 主端并响应 MiniMCProto v2.0 串口帧。"""
+    rx_buf = bytearray()
+    seq_state: Dict[str, int] = {"mc_seq": 1, "th_seq": 2}
+    while True:
+        try:
+            rlist, _, _ = select.select([master_fd], [], [], 0.2)
+        except InterruptedError:
+            continue
+        if not rlist:
+            continue
+        try:
+            chunk = os.read(master_fd, 256)
+        except OSError as exc:
+            if exc.errno in (errno.EIO, errno.EAGAIN):
+                time.sleep(0.02)
+                continue
+            break
+        if not chunk:
+            break
+        rx_buf.extend(chunk)
+        while len(rx_buf) >= 14:
+            idx = rx_buf.find(b"\x55\xaa")
+            if idx < 0:
+                rx_buf.clear()
+                break
+            if idx > 0:
+                del rx_buf[:idx]
+            if len(rx_buf) < 14:
+                break
+            plen = struct.unpack("<H", rx_buf[10:12])[0]
+            flen = 14 + plen
+            if len(rx_buf) < flen:
+                break
+            pkt = bytes(rx_buf[:flen])
+            del rx_buf[:flen]
+            resp = build_pty_response_for_req(pkt, work_path, seq_state)
+            if resp is not None:
+                os.write(master_fd, resp)
+

+def start_pty_daemon(work_path: pathlib.Path) -> int:
+    """创建 921600 兼容 POSIX PTY 并启动后台虚拟 MCU 守护进程。"""
+    work_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    master_fd, slave_fd = pty.openpty()
+    attrs = termios.tcgetattr(slave_fd)
+    attrs[0] = 0
+    attrs[1] = 0
+    attrs[3] = 0
+    termios.tcsetattr(slave_fd, termios.TCSANOW, attrs)
+    slave_name = os.ttyname(slave_fd)
+    (work_path / "pty_path").write_text(slave_name, encoding="utf-8")
+    (work_path / "pty_mode").write_text("ONLINE", encoding="utf-8")
+    (work_path / "pty_last_seq.json").write_text(json.dumps({"mc_seq": 1, "th_seq": 2}), encoding="utf-8")
+    pid = os.fork()
+    if pid > 0:
+        os.close(master_fd)
+        os.close(slave_fd)
+        (work_path / "pty_pid").write_text(str(pid), encoding="utf-8")
+        return 0
+    os.setsid()
+    devnull_fd = os.open("/dev/null", os.O_RDWR)
+    os.dup2(devnull_fd, 0)
+    os.dup2(devnull_fd, 1)
+    os.dup2(devnull_fd, 2)
+    if devnull_fd > 2:
+        os.close(devnull_fd)
+    try:
+        pty_responder_loop(master_fd, work_path)
+    finally:
+        os.close(master_fd)
+        os.close(slave_fd)
+        os._exit(0)
